answer: Each identity registers one apiary: hives on a basalt site, a health certificate signed with the inspector's quill each season. One apiary backs one identity; a shared site or duplicate hive ID merges both into one weight. A fake costs one real apiary: 600 units for hives, queen and bees, 150 in fees, and 12 months of feeding and disease checks. A paper apiary fails the visit: no live colony, no foragers spiral out, no honey record. Forged certificates fail the register check, and an inspector signing phantom colonies loses their licence and all they certified.
